rationale: Record test-only restructuring of Pulp's real-browser capture validation. The 26 existing real-browser cases move unchanged from one file into three themed *.integration.test.mjs files over a shared support module and run under node --test --test-concurrency=3 inside the same RUN_SERIAL ctest entry, so isolation from other CTest work and every per-case and outer timeout are unchanged. The test-only browser resolver now refuses the runner image's system Chrome under GitHub Actions and requires the pinned PULP_DESIGN_BROWSER, and one case covers that rule. Production browser capture, design ingest, captured output, rendering, packaging, the accepted expansion boundary, and Vellum source authority are unchanged.
tests: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true node --test --test-concurrency=3 tools/import-design/browser_capture/*.integration.test.mjs without PULP_DESIGN_BROWSER (23 real-browser cases skipped, 4 passed)
